newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse edges higher, bottler and banks firm.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse edges higher, bottler and banks firm.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed up by 0.66 percent driven by beer and Coke bottler SFBT and banks.
The 31-share index closed at 492.45 from 489.23 on Thursday.
Volume was 1.20 million dinars against 1.06 million dinars.
Higher demand took SFBT up by 6.9 dinars to 86 dinars. BIAT bank was higher 2.58 dinars to 33 dinars with 5,769 shares changing hands.
Banque de l'Habitat gained 1.76 dinars to 21.08 dinars, Banque Nationale Agricole rose 0.9 dinar to 30.97,while Arab Tunisian Bank edged up 0.74 dinar to 30.74.
